verdict.rationale: Plausible's core value proposition is cookieless tracking with no personal data collection, explicitly stated as 'collects no personal data and requires no consent banner,' corroborated by community discussion of its privacy/GDPR posture and lack of IP storage. This directly matches the founder story of avoiding consent banners while tracking usage. missing for 10: independent legal/compliance audit confirming banner-free status across all jurisdictions.
